findings.title: Employee counted at two worksites in one month — clear-cut
findings.why_it_matters: The engine counts headcount per unit, so a person appearing at two worksites in the same month is counted twice. That inflates Average Headcount, which inflates the credit. In these one worksite holds at least 75% of the month's hours, so which unit owns the head is arithmetic rather than a judgement.
findings.proposed_effect: Counts each employee at their dominant worksite for that month.

findings.title: Employee counted at two worksites in one month — split evenly

rules.name: Tennessee Job Tax Credit
rules.prototype_verification: PROTOTYPE rule pack. Core parameters VERIFIED against T.C.A. § 67-4-2109 (2024 Tennessee Code, via Justia — see _sources): base Job Tax Credit = $4,500 per qualified job, statewide, for making the $500,000 required capital investment AND creating at least 25 qualified jobs (reduced to 20 jobs in a tier 3, and 10 jobs in a tier 4, enhancement county). A qualified job = a permanent position of at least 37.5 hours/week for 12 consecutive months; part-time (>=20 hrs/wk) and seasonal (>=26 wks) each count as 0.5 job. Enhancement counties (tier 2/3/4) earn an ADDITIONAL annual credit of $4,500/job for 3-5 years. Unused credit carries forward 15 years (25 years for credits earned in tax years ending on/after 12/31/2008). Per the partner (7/9/26) eligibility is STATEWIDE (no pinpointer gate); geography changes the dollar value only. The weekly-WAGE floor is NOT in the statute (it requires 37.5 hrs + minimum health care) and remains _prototype_verify pending the partner. NOTE: a post-7/1/2025 version of the statute exists; confirm the current text before client use.

filing.window: TN Form FAE170 by franchise/excise due date

one_zero._doc_source: min_weekly_hours 37.5 VERIFIED vs T.C.A. § 67-4-2109(a)(6)(A)(i) (qualified job = 37.5 hrs/wk, 12 consecutive months). See _sources.
one_zero._note: Statewide (geographic_granularity=statewide). min_weekly_hours=37.5 is statutory. The statute has NO weekly-WAGE floor (it requires 37.5 hrs + minimum health care); min_weekly_wages=600 is a PROTOTYPE placeholder (_prototype_verify) pending the partner. Statute counts part-time (>=20 hrs/wk) and seasonal (>=26 wks) as 0.5 job — pt_band/pt_weight NOT yet activated in the engine to avoid changing demo numbers; activate with the partner's sign-off. entity_combination pending DISC-4.
